name: check-completion
purpose: Classify whether a bounded agent task appears complete from the supplied evidence.
boundary: Jev supplies a second-pass completion signal only. Tests, diffs, reviewers, and users remain the proof of completion.

questions.question: What completion state is supported by the evidence?

options.meaning: The requested bounded outcome appears satisfied.
Some requested work appears done but important parts remain.
The work could not continue without new information or access.
The evidence does not support the completion claim.

questions.question: The evidence stays within the requested scope.
